tools.name: find_work_email
tools.description: Find a person's verified work email from first name, last name and company domain (live SMTP check, catch-all detection).

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Check whether an email address is deliverable (MX, provider, catch-all, live SMTP RCPT).

tools.name: domain_email_intel
tools.description: A company's email setup: provider, catch-all, SaaS tools from SPF, DMARC, public emails, likely pattern.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_work_email, verify_email · Public sink: find_work_email, verify_email, domain_email_intel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_work_email, verify_email · Public sink: find_work_email, verify_email, domain_email_intel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
